integrity: The structural claim uses a Markov reduction, parity of period classes, and a rooted-map relabeling bijection. The exact count and its expansion are consequences of the established A000698 sequence and the cited factorial asymptotic theorem. Finite computations check only bounded instances.
scientific_limitations: Odd numbers of equal interval cells and the slope-two tent map; mixing in the Markov sense. No conditional transfer-spectrum result or originality claim for the numerical sequence or its asymptotic is made.
title: Rooted-map classes of mixing odd-grid tent shuffles
